Subject: Reboarding request — new remit & contact

Hi Laura,

Hope you’re well. We need to update our vendor remit information in Redwood ahead of a systems migration on our side. Effective 2026-08-01, please change Clearline Logistics’ ACH details to the attached ACH authorization and switch the remit-to mailing address to: 412 Harborview Drive, Suite 210, Portland, OR 97217.

Also please update our AP primary contact to: Nora Stephens, Senior AP Manager (nora.stephens@clearline.com, +1-503-555-0142). The AP inbox (ap@clearline.com) should remain on file for remittance notifications.

I’ve attached a completed ACH authorization (Clearline-ACH-authorization.pdf) and a scanned W-9. We’re planning final production invoices week of 2026-08-03 and would appreciate confirmation that the vendor record has been updated before then.

Thanks in advance for the assist — let me know if you need anything else to complete the change.

Best,
Nora
Clearline Logistics

Subject: Re: Reboarding request — new remit & contact

Hi Nora — thanks for sending this over. Quick checklist from our side to complete the vendor update: 

- We need the scanned voided check or bank letter (the ACH form is great but finance requires bank verification).
- Confirm the taxpayer name on the W-9 matches the vendor legal name on file (Clearline Logistics LLC).
- Please confirm whether you accept PO terms with remittance changes; we will route payments to the new account once verification is complete.

I’ve looped in Karthik (Finance) to validate bank docs and Jonas (CS/Onboarding) to make sure the vendor portal records are updated so POs and remittance notices route correctly. Our standard processing window is typically 3–5 business days after receiving verification documents.

If helpful, you can update the vendor portal directly here: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/update/clearline-12345 and attach the voided check. Otherwise attach to this thread.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally and share status.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
